Da Vinci/Voice options

Finding Da Vinci’s voice

Round three: six mature male voices at a natural assistant pace — steady, warm, empathetic, and clear, with a refined British delivery. Each reads the same paragraph so they compare fairly.

The audition script

“Good morning, Ross. Revenue is up 12 percent this week — 128 thousand dollars across 1,284 orders. Your Spring Style Refresh campaign is performing well, with a 42 percent open rate so far. One thing needs your attention: eleven orders are waiting on fulfillment because the Aurora Trail Jacket is low on stock. I’ve already drafted a restock request with your supplier, and queued a back-in-stock email for the 86 customers on the waitlist. Just say the word, and I’ll send both.”

Option 1 · Algieba

Smooth · lower pitch

Smooth and even — the most effortless listen in the lineup.

Option 2 · Algenib

Gravelly · lower pitch

A touch of gravel — the most distinctive texture, mature and grounded.

Option 3 · Iapetus

Clear

The cleanest articulation — crisp consonants, easy on numbers.

Option 4 · Alnilam

Firm

Steady and assured — a voice that sounds certain of its answers.

Option 5 · Sadaltager

Knowledgeable

Measured and knowledgeable — the seasoned-advisor read.

Option 6 · Charon

Informative · current voice

Today’s Da Vinci voice under the new direction — the baseline to beat.
